$why: Moved out of lib/ac-gate.js on 2026-08-16. Missed by the prose guard because it opens with
an imperative verb the pattern set did not carry -- one more demonstration that matching
prose reports a floor. Found by looking for the SHAPE instead: a multi-line literal.
Routes one ticket to one codeline, or to the split value when the work spans several. The
split value is supplied rather than named here: which sentinel means 'spans codelines' is
the engine's business, and a prompt that spells it out drifts from the code that reads it.
description: Assigns a single Jira story to exactly one codeline, or marks it as spanning several.
body:
Assign this Jira story to a codeline. Answer with JSON only — no prose, no markdown fences.

STORY: __JIRA_KEY__ — __TITLE__

DESCRIPTION:
__DESCRIPTION__

CODELINES:
__CODELINE_LIST__
- "__SPLIT_VALUE__" — the work spans multiple codelines

Choose exactly one. Answer:
{"codeline": "<one of the values above>"}
